name: Thermal Power & Steam Mechanical Drive Package
description: Industrial steam power generation and mechanical shaft drive package with HP steam boiler, electro-hydraulic throttle valve, multi-stage expansion turbine, mechanical shaft torque transmission, driven centrifugal compressor, and surface condenser.
author: NebuDCS Standard Library
control_strategies: SIC-201 Electronic Governor Speed Regulation via Throttle Valve
PIC-201 Downstream Compressor Discharge Pressure Regulation
Emergency Overspeed Quick-Trip Latch (> 3800 RPM shutoff)
PIC-202 Surface Condenser Vacuum Pressure Control
validation_rules: VLD-PWR01: Steam turbine shaft_out must connect to rotating load with PortDomain::Mechanical
VLD-PWR02: Turbine throttle valve must fail closed (FailClosed) upon trip or loss of signal
